title: The Man Who Gave Hearts a Second Chance
hook: Imagine waking up after a surgery to hear your own voice for the first time in weeks. That was the reality for the first patient to receive a human heart transplant, and the story behind it is as human as the organ itself.

title: How Rugby Union Got Its Shape
hook: You might think rugby is just a modern sport, but its rules and rivalries grew out of schoolyard fights and class battles.

title: Why a Minimum Wage Isn’t Just a Number
hook: When you see a price tag on a coffee, you don’t think about labor costs. Yet that hidden floor on wages shapes everything from a braai stall to a tech startup.

title: Why does a microwave heat your food but not the plate?
hook: Put a bowl of soup in the microwave for two minutes and the soup comes out steaming, while the plate underneath is barely warm.

title: Why do we have leap years?
hook: Every four years February gets an extra day.
